terms.title: Amategeko n'Amahame ya Umuryango
terms.subtitle: Soma amategeko n'amahame yacu mbere yo gufungura konti yawe.
terms.section1_body: Umuryango ukoreshwa ku buntu rwose mu muryango wawe. Nta kiguzi cy'iyandikisha cyangwa amafaranga ahishe bisabwa.
terms.section2_title: 2. Nta makuru afatwa ku nyungu zacu
terms.section2_body: Ntabwo dufata, tugurisha, cyangwa ngo dukoreshe amakuru yawe cyangwa ay'umutungo w'umuryango wawe mu nyungu zacu bwite cyangwa kwamamaza.
terms.section3_body: Amakuru yawe aba arinzwe kandi atekanye. Si buri wese ushobora kuyageraho—abanyamuryango bemewe gusa ni bo bashobora kubona inyandiko zemerewe.
terms.section4_body: Iyi porogaramu itangwa uko iri nta ngwate n'imwe. Hari ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose cyabaho—nk'ibura ry'amakuru cyangwa kutumvikana mu muryango—ntabwo tubibazwa, ntuzatubaze!
family_setup.title: Tunganya umuryango wawe
family_setup.subtitle: Hitamo uko ushaka gutangira gucunga umutungo w'umuryango wawe muri Umuryango.
family_setup.create_desc: Fungura urubuga rushya rw'umuryango maze utumire abagize urugo.
family_setup.join_desc: Injira mu rubuga rw'umuryango rusanzwe ukoresheje ubutumire bw'umuyobozi w'umuryango.
family_setup.selected_create: Wahisemo gutangiza umuryango. Urubuga rushya rw'umuryango wawe rugiye gutunganywa.
family_setup.selected_join: Wahisemo kwinjira mu muryango. Shyiramo ubutumire bw'umuryango wawe.
family_setup.selected_skip: Wasimbutse gutunganya umuryango ubu. Ushobora kuwutangiza cyangwa kwinjiramo nyuma.
family_setup.invited_families_desc: Watumiwe muri iyi miryango binyuze kuri telefone yawe:
create_family.title: Tangiza Umuryango
create_family.subtitle: Shyiraho izina ry'umuryango wawe maze utumire abanyamuryango ukoresheje telefone.
